candidates.change_summary: Remove the require statement, so depositsCount can overflow/underflow without restriction, changing subsequent receive behavior.
Remove the depositsCount increment, so the counter never changes on receive, altering its value after subsequent calls.
Replace pre-increment require check with a different expression that always reverts, so receive always fails and depositsCount never changes.
Replace depositsCount++ with a different arithmetic operation (e.g., += 2), causing depositsCount to differ after receive.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from withdrawAll, making it callable by anyone
Replace the body of withdrawAll with an empty block, so it withdraws nothing
Replace withdraw(address(this).balance) with withdraw(0), so withdrawAll transfers 0 wei
Delete the require statement in onlyOwner, removing the access control check
Replace transfer call with a selfdestruct to force a balance change without updating internal state, making subsequent withdraw observable balance differ.
Remove the transfer statement so withdraw does not actually send funds, causing withdraw to leave contract balance unchanged.
Insert a condition that only transfers if value is less than address balance, otherwise reverts, changing when withdraw succeeds.
Delete the require check in the modifier, allowing anyone to call withdraw and change the contract balance observable via subsequent owner calls.
Replace msg.sender with tx.origin in the modifier, changing who is considered owner and thus who can withdraw.
